newsitem.title: CHINA: China January CPI up 5.9 pct yr/yr-official.
newsitem.headline: China January CPI up 5.9 pct yr/yr-official.

text.p: China's consumer price inflation rose by a year-on-year 5.9 percent in January, the State Statistical Bureau said in a statement issued by the Xinhua news agency.
That compared with a year-on-year increase of 6.9 percent in November of last year, it said but gave no further details.
China did not release a figure for December.
Retail price inflation, the figure China uses as its benchmark for nationwide inflation, was 3.3 percent in January.
China's consumer price inflation for 1996 was 8.3 percent.
